title: EnConvo as a reasoning and action engine
description: EnConvo joins Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes and Grok Build. Mavis or any custom EnConvo agent can think and act for each character through EnConvo's local API, keeping its own model, tools and account.
highlights: Settings → Reasoning → EnConvo · local agent, and Action engine → EnConvo. Uses the EnConvo app's local API (http://localhost:54535 by default, configurable).
Agents for each character gains an EnConvo column listing Mavis and every custom EnConvo agent; bind a different agent to each avatar.
Each EnConvo agent keeps its own model, tools, account and permissions; only transcript text and the avatar tool instructions are sent.
With actions enabled, requests go to the action engine: choose Follow reasoning agent or EnConvo there to route through EnConvo.
Facial expression timing refined: brow gestures flash and rest instead of holding, and repeated feelings never restart a wink.
